title: 第1363章 李秀宁历练收获颇丰第1362章 即将到达隆北关一众朝廷老狐狸的算计
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
中军大帐内，
镇国公李元龙端坐于虎皮帅位之上，
面色沉静如水，修长的手指有节奏地敲击着紫檀木桌面，
发出“笃、笃”的沉闷声响，每一下都仿佛敲在下方之人的心头。
下方，副将李万虎身披重甲，神色肃穆，正声如洪钟地汇报着最新战况。
“大帅！根据左路军传来消息，我大萧皇朝左路军统帅镇南侯卫武义所率大军势如破竹，连克数城，
预计最多三日，便可彻底扫荡隆北关东北方向的所有城池，斩断其左臂！
而右路军统帅、镇南王萧玉南的大军，虽遇些许顽强抵抗，
但凭借绝对优势，十日内也能荡平西北方向的城池，
届时两军合拢，便可对隆北关形成铁桶般的合围之势！”
副将李万虎的声音铿锵有力，透着一股必胜的信心与杀伐之气。
听完汇报后，
大帅镇国公李元龙只是微微点了点头，发出一声低沉的“嗯”，
神色并未有太大的波澜，仿佛这一切都在他的预料之中，
那份泰山崩于前而色不变的定力，令人折服。
随即，
他的目光越过众将，投向了大帐角落阴影处一道全身被黑袍笼罩的身影：密谍司副司主，萧无影。
感受到主帅那如有实质、仿佛能穿透人心的目光，
副司主萧无影缓缓抬起头，兜帽下的声音洪厚而阴冷，
“大帅！正如您所料，密谍司在大魏皇朝各地的分部已全力运转，如同一张无形的大网。

通过外围人员的刻意散布与推波助澜，如今大魏境内的商贾、地方豪强已是人心惶惶，如惊弓之鸟。
他们忙着寻找靠山、转移资产，根本无心抵抗我大萧皇朝的天威。
不少城池的守军甚至已经动摇，只待我军兵临城下，便会夹道欢迎，献城投降。”
副司主萧无影顿了顿，黑袍下的声音透着刺骨的寒意与嘲弄，
“更有不少富商巨贾，为了保命，正疯狂变卖祖产，如丧家之犬般试图逃离大魏皇朝疆域。
偌大一个皇朝，如今已是人心离散、千疮百孔，这大厦将倾，不过是旦夕之间的事了。”
“至于那个被秘密押送往大萧都城的羽东侯薛霸……？”
副司主萧无影话锋一转，语气变得凝重起来，
“这一路上，他遭遇的刺杀不下十起，手段层出不穷。
若非大帅早有先见之明，派遣了朝廷供奉殿的高手暗中护送，
只怕他早就成了亡魂，身首异处了。”
“但‘幽狱’中的卧底传来最新密报！
大魏皇帝魏渊已下‘绝户令’！宁可让幽狱精锐尽出、血洗沿途，
也绝不容薛霸活着踏入大萧都城半步！这是要彻底断了他的生路，杀人灭口！”
副司主萧无影抬起头，黑袍下的目光闪烁不定，
“情况不容乐观，大魏皇朝的皇帝魏渊这是要杀人灭口，掩盖真相。
相信接下来，敌人会派出修为更高的杀手，甚至是那些隐世不出的老怪物。”
听到这里，
大帅镇国公李元龙眼中闪过一丝意外。
他没想到，那个平日里看似温吞、最擅长玩弄帝王平衡术的魏渊，

在关键时刻，
竟也有如此狠辣果决的一面，当真是人不可貌相。
“不过，哼，想杀人灭口？”
镇国公李元龙冷笑一声，眼中闪过一丝轻蔑与不屑，
content_en:
Inside the Chinese army’s tent,
Li Yuanlong, the Duke of the town, sat on the tiger-skin commander's throne.
His face was as calm as water, and his slender fingers tapped the rosewood table rhythmically.
It made a dull sound of "Tuk, Tuk", and each blow seemed to hit the heart of the person below.
Below, deputy general Li Wanhu was wearing heavy armor, with a solemn expression, and reported the latest battle situation in a serious voice.
"Commander! According to the news from the Left Army, the army led by the Commander-in-Chief of the Left Army of the Great Xiao Dynasty, Zhennan Hou Wei Wuyi, is overwhelming and can conquer several cities.
It is expected that in up to three days, all the cities northeast of Longbeiguan can be completely swept away and his left arm can be cut off!
Although the army of Xiao Yunan, commander of the Right Army Army and King of Zhennan, encountered some stubborn resistance,
But with the absolute advantage, the city in the northwest can be wiped out within ten days.
When the two armies join together, they can form an iron barrel-like encirclement of Longbeiguan Pass! "
Lieutenant General Li Wanhu's voice was sonorous and powerful, revealing a sense of confidence and killing intent to win.
After listening to the report,
Li Yuanlong, the commander-in-chief of the town, just nodded slightly and said a low "hmm",
His expression didn't show much disturbance, as if everything was within his expectation.
The determination that remains unchanged despite the collapse of Mount Tai is impressive.
Immediately,
He looked past the generals and towards a figure shrouded in black robes in the shadows of the corner of the tent: Xiao Wuying, deputy chief of the Secret Intelligence Department.
Feeling the coach's eyes that seemed to have substance and could penetrate people's hearts,
Deputy Chief Xiao Wuying slowly raised his head, the voice under the hood was loud and cold,
"Commander! As you expected, the branches of the Secret Intelligence Service in various parts of the Wei Dynasty are operating at full capacity, like an invisible network.
Through the deliberate spreading and fueling of the situation by peripheral personnel, the merchants and local powerful people in the Wei Dynasty are now as frightened as a frightened bird.
They are busy looking for backers and transferring assets, and have no intention of resisting the power of our Great Xiao Dynasty.
The defenders of many cities have even wavered. As soon as our troops approach the city, they will line up to welcome them and surrender. "
Deputy Chief Xiao Wuying paused, and the voice under the black robe was filled with biting chill and ridicule.
"There are also many wealthy businessmen who are frantically selling off their ancestral properties in order to save their lives, trying to escape from the territory of the Wei Dynasty like a bereaved dog.
The people of this huge dynasty are now scattered and riddled with holes. This edifice will collapse in just a matter of seconds. "
"As for the Yu Donghou Xue Ba who was secretly escorted to the capital of Xiao...?"
Deputy Chief Xiao Wuying changed the topic and his tone became solemn,
“He encountered no fewer than ten assassinations along the way, and the methods were endless.
If the commander-in-chief hadn’t had the foresight to send experts from the imperial enshrinement hall to secretly escort him,
I'm afraid that he has become a dead soul long ago, and his body and head are in a different place. "
“But the undercover agent in ‘Ghost’ sent the latest tip!
The Emperor of the Wei Dynasty, Wei Yuan, has issued an ‘extermination order’! I would rather let all the elites from hell come out and wash out the blood along the way,
Xue Ba will never be allowed to enter the capital of Xiao alive! This is to completely cut off his way of life and silence him! "
Deputy Chief Xiao Wuying raised his head, his eyes flickering under the black robe.
"The situation is not optimistic. Wei Yuan, the emperor of the Wei Dynasty, wants to kill people and silence them and cover up the truth.
I believe that next, the enemy will send out killers with higher cultivation levels, even those old monsters who have never left the world. "
Hearing this,
A hint of surprise flashed in Li Yuanlong's eyes.
He didn't expect that Wei Yuan, who usually seemed meek and was best at playing the Emperor's Balance Technique, would
At a critical moment,
He actually has such a ruthless and decisive side, he really cannot be judged by his appearance.
"But, huh, you want to kill people and silence them?"
Duke Li Yuanlong sneered, a trace of contempt and disdain flashed in his eyes,
